checks.evidence: Proof tamper gate active in .github/workflows/verify.yml.
checks.why: A local lockfile alone can be regenerated inside a PR; comparing against the trusted base branch makes test/harness tampering unforgeable.

checks.title: Hash-chained PROOF_CHANGELOG.md attestation ledger
checks.evidence: PROOF_CHANGELOG.md hash chain is valid.
checks.why: Provides an append-only tamper-evident audit trail of verified commits and intentional harness/test re-seals.

checks.title: Tracked pre-commit & pre-push verification bash hooks
checks.evidence: .githooks/pre-commit and .githooks/pre-push exist, but git core.hooksPath is not set locally.
checks.why: Blocks LLMs and developers locally from committing or pushing failing/untested code, saving CI cycles while CI remains the unbypassable boundary.
checks.recommendation: Track .githooks/pre-commit and .githooks/pre-push (sealed in proof-lock.json) and activate with git config core.hooksPath .githooks.

fixes.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Layer 1 local guardrail: blocks LLMs and developers from committing
# untested, failing, or tamper-violating changes.
echo "[agentic-uplift] Running pre-commit verification gate..."
if [ -f "package.json" ] && grep -q '"verify:fast"' package.json; then
  npm run verify:fast
elif [ -f "package.json" ] && grep -q '"verify"' package.json; then
  npm run verify
else
  npm test
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Layer 1 pre-push verification gate: runs full verification + proof check
# before pushing commits to remote.
echo "[agentic-uplift] Running full pre-push verification gate..."
if [ -f "package.json" ] && grep -q '"verify"' package.json; then
  npm run verify
else
  npm test
fi

checks.title: CODEOWNERS protects proof-lock, hooks, and CI workflows
checks.evidence: .github/CODEOWNERS requires human review for proof-lock.json, hooks, and workflows.
checks.why: Ensures an autonomous agent PR cannot modify verification workflows, git hooks, or lockfiles without explicit maintainer sign-off.

checks.title: Automated tests present in repository
checks.evidence: Found 24 automated test file(s) across 80 repository files.
checks.why: Autonomous edits without automated tests cannot be verified deterministically.

checks.title: CI runs automated verification on every pull request
checks.evidence: PR test verification runs in .github/workflows/verify.yml.
checks.why: PR CI is the non-bypassable execution boundary validating agent-authored code.

checks.title: Default branch protection / required status checks
checks.evidence: Branch protection requires GitHub API access (skipped in offline local mode).
checks.why: Prevents direct pushes to the default branch and enforces required CI + tamper-gate checks before merge.
checks.recommendation: Apply a branch ruleset on claude/project-thread-24xnrt requiring PR reviews, CODEOWNERS approval, and the 4-Tier Verification & PR Tamper Gate check(s).

checks.title: Default-branch CI stays green
checks.evidence: Waiting for GitHub Actions run history.
checks.why: Agents operating on a red default branch compound failures instead of converging.

checks.title: Declarative uplift.config.json policy file
checks.evidence: uplift.config.json defines proof zones, SLA limits, and gate policy.
checks.why: Gives both humans and agents a single typed source of truth for verification zones, limits, and circuit-breaker thresholds.

checks.title: GitHub Actions pinned to full 40-character commit SHAs
checks.evidence: All third-party action references across 3 workflow(s) are pinned to commit SHAs.
checks.why: Prevents mutable tag hijacking in automated workflows that hold repository or agent credentials.

checks.title: Least-privilege permissions declared in every workflow
checks.evidence: Every workflow declares explicit top-level `permissions:`.
checks.why: Limits blast radius of untrusted PRs or prompt-injected agent runs.

checks.title: Dependency lockfile or zero third-party runtime dependencies
checks.evidence: Zero third-party runtime dependencies declared (minimal supply-chain footprint).
checks.why: Ensures deterministic installs and prevents unexpected upstream supply-chain drift.

checks.title: SECURITY.md private vulnerability reporting policy
checks.evidence: SECURITY.md is present.
checks.why: Directs researchers to private reporting channels instead of public issues.

checks.title: Package install lifecycle scripts disabled by default
checks.evidence: Zero third-party runtime dependencies declared; no install scripts can run.
checks.why: A compromised dependency runs arbitrary code at install time through preinstall/install/postinstall scripts, before any test or review.

checks.title: Repository secrets kept out of jobs that run package code
checks.evidence: No workflow job combines repository secrets with package installs or scripts.
checks.why: Any install script or transitive dependency running in a job can read every secret that job holds.

checks.title: Coding-agent API keys isolated from package code and shell tools
checks.evidence: No coding-agent jobs detected.
checks.why: A prompt-injected agent with Bash, or a malicious package in the same job, can exfiltrate the model API key.

checks.title: actions/checkout does not leave git tokens in .git/config
checks.evidence: Every non-pushing job checks out with persist-credentials: false.
checks.why: actions/checkout writes the job token to .git/config by default, where later package code can read it.

checks.title: CI package installs screened at install time (Socket Firewall)
checks.evidence: Zero third-party runtime dependencies (not applicable).
checks.why: PR-time dependency review misses malicious packages fetched directly in CI; install-time screening blocks confirmed malware before it runs.

checks.title: AGENTS.md operating model covers verification, TDD, security, and attribution
checks.evidence: AGENTS.md covers all 7 required operating topics.
checks.why: Gives every coding agent clear build/test commands, security boundaries (untrusted issue text), and non-negotiable proof rules.

checks.title: Autonomous issue resolution guarded by circuit breaker
checks.evidence: Circuit-broken resolution workflow found in .github/workflows/agent-resolve.yml.
checks.why: Serializes agent runs and automatically pauses when the proof seal breaks, open agent PRs hit the cap, budgets trip, or main CI goes red.

checks.title: Agent work attributed via account or Co-Authored-By trailers
checks.evidence: Waiting for PR/commit attribution history (requires GitHub API mode).
checks.why: Measures whether AI agents actually reduce backlog and maintain quality over time.

checks.title: Structured GitHub issue forms for triage and SLAs
checks.evidence: Structured issue templates found under .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/.
checks.why: Labels issues consistently (security, bug, enhancement) so agents and SLA monitors prioritize accurately.

checks.title: Pull request template requiring linked issues and verification summary
checks.evidence: Pull request template is present.
checks.why: Standardizes `Fixes #123` links and verification proof summaries across human and agent PRs.

checks.title: Closed issues link back to a verifiable fix
checks.evidence: Waiting for at least 5 closed issues to evaluate closure verification rate.
checks.why: Separates real fixes from silent closures without commits or PRs.

checks.title: Agentic spend and budget guardrails configured
checks.evidence: No monthly agentic budget configured yet.
checks.why: Prevents runaway autonomous API/CI loops by letting resolve-gate trip automatically at budget limits.
checks.recommendation: Configure monthly-agentic-budget in your uplift workflow or uplift.config.json.
